schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

## Mastodon — Ruby on Rails backend + Node/Yarn frontend & streaming server.
## Flox pins the language runtimes and the system libraries the native gems need;
## bundler and yarn install the actual gems/packages on activate. Postgres and
## Redis run as Flox services so `flox activate --start-services` brings up the
## whole dev stack. Elasticsearch and LibreTranslate stay optional (see report).

[install]
# --- Language runtimes ---
ruby.pkg-path = "ruby"                 # .ruby-version pins 4.0.6 (not in catalog); Gemfile allows >=3.3.0,<4.1.0 -> 3.4.9
nodejs_24.pkg-path = "nodejs_24"       # .nvmrc 24.18 / engines.node >=22
yarn-berry_4.pkg-path = "yarn-berry_4" # packageManager yarn@4.17.1

# --- Databases (run as Flox services below) ---
postgresql_14.pkg-path = "postgresql_14" # docker-compose db: postgres:14-alpine; also provides libpq/pg_config for the pg gem
redis.pkg-path = "redis"                 # docker-compose redis: redis:7-alpine

# --- System libraries for native gems / media processing ---
pkg-config.pkg-path = "pkg-config"     # build glue for native gem extensions
libidn.pkg-path = "libidn"             # idn-ruby gem (Aptfile: libidn12)
icu.pkg-path = "icu"                   # charlock_holmes gem (devcontainer: libicu-dev)
vips_8_17.pkg-path = "vips_8_17"        # ruby-vips image processing (devcontainer: libvips42)
ffmpeg.pkg-path = "ffmpeg"             # media transcoding

# --- Optional PAM auth (Linux-only; devcontainer: libpam-dev) ---
linux-pam.pkg-path = "linux-pam"
linux-pam.systems = ["x86_64-linux", "aarch64-linux"]

[vars]
# Postgres — matches config/database.yml env keys and the Flox postgres service
DB_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
DB_PORT = "5432"
DB_USER = "postgres"
DB_NAME = "mastodon_development"
PGHOST = "127.0.0.1"
PGPORT = "5432"
PGUSER = "postgres"
PGDATABASE = "mastodon_development"
# Redis — matches the Flox redis service
REDIS_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
REDIS_PORT = "6379"

[hook]
on-activate = """
  # --- Ruby gems (kept in the project-local cache, not the system) ---
  export BUNDLE_PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/bundle"
  export BUNDLE_APP_CONFIG="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/bundle/config"
  mkdir -p "$BUNDLE_PATH"
  gem install bundler --conservative --no-document >&2
  if ! bundle check >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Installing Ruby gems (bundle install) — first run can take a few minutes..." >&2
    bundle install --jobs 4 >&2
  fi

  # --- JS deps (Yarn 4 / Berry) ---
  export COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0
  if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
    yarn install --immutable >&2
  fi

  # --- Postgres data dir bootstrap (first activate only) ---
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" \
      --username="$PGUSER" \
      --auth=trust \
      --no-locale \
      --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -o "-p $PGPORT -k /tmp" -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start
    until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" -q; do sleep 0.2; done
    createdb
